body.p: Once upon a time the Fox and the Raven were quarrelling. The Raven wished it to be daylight all the time, because he was unable to find his food in the dark; but the Fox wanted it to be dark, because he could smell his food, and approach it without being seen. Finally they settled that light and darkness should alternate.
